patchNotes: Prioritized ICARUS as the core hands-free assistant instead of automatically entering Driving Mode.
Hardened the opt-in wake-word service lifecycle and recovery behavior.
Connected native voice transcripts to the assistant and preserved Driving Mode voice routing when already driving.
Added hands-free confirmation and cancellation for protected device actions.
Reduced wake-listener dead zones and added voice barge-in protection against self-transcription.
Passed 100 of 100 deterministic wake and voice control-path simulations.
